author: GamingBolt
description:
We jumped at the chance to try out Derelikt for ourselves, the PS1-inspired graphics and gameplay drawing us in for the pure nostalgia of playing a game inspired by some of the finest early titles to grace the FPS genre. We're glad we did, for the most part, although exploring the Von Neumann outpost, where this one takes place, has come with a few problems that make it an annoying stage to let the adventure unfold on.

Nevertheless, there was enough steam in this one to help us power through those issues, and discover an intriguing, if not groundbreaking, story and world on offer. 

You can’t trust anyone at the outpost, but you can surely trust us when we tell you this one could be worth your time. Join us and find out why that’s the case.
title: DERELIKT Review - PS1 Nostalgia That Mostly Delivers

author: GamingBolt
description:
Game of the generation, the next frontier of video games, raising the bar on the genre – whichever of the many descriptors used for Grand Theft Auto 6, one thing remained patently clear: It was Rockstar's gamble to lose. Only through grievous error or supernatural forces could it possibly flop. Not only is it beloved among critics, scoring a 99 Metascore – the highest of the year according to both Metacritic and OpenCritic – but it's also a massive commercial success. Rockstar has confirmed the numbers: 32.5 million pre-release sales, resulting in a whopping $3.79 billion in day-one sales.

It's officially the “biggest entertainment launch in history,” and as the developer rightfully points out, it's set a “new record for entertainment across any medium.”
title: GTA 6 Shatters Records: 32.5 Million Copies, Beats Avengers Endgame, Infinity War And Brand New Day

author: GamingBolt
description:
GTA 6 has finally revealed the full scope of its ambitions to the world, and it’s certainly something to stop and pick your jaw up off the floor when Loenida’s sheer density, scale, and detail come at you with full force. We’ve had a lot of those moments, and brought some of them to a list for you to check out if you’re just getting started with the game.

There’s a lot of fun stuff, so join us as we take you around Leonida and fill you in on some of the sights you should be looking out for as you allow the city to cast its spell on you in a way that only Rockstar can manage today.
title: GTA 6 - 15 INCREDIBLE Examples of Attention To Detail (PART 1)
